reviewer: OMP agent (M15 development and release images)
note: IMAGE-005 validate ext4 image: src/images/ext4.zig puts the exported rootfs into a disposable ext4 image, reads the contents and modes back with debugfs so looking at bytes needs no privileges, and then performs a real loop mount through sudo and reads the same file through the kernel's interpretation of the filesystem, unmounting afterwards with the mount point checked empty. The contract's owner-execute bit is compared exactly in both directions, because a declared plain file that gained one is not the declared payload either. Evidence is recorded inside the WSL2 guest, so actualPlatform is linux-x86_64. As with IMAGE-004, the test is skipped rather than failed on hosts the case does not name, so the host suite stays green while the platform evidence remains the guest's. Fault proof: disabling the digest comparison lets a mismatched filesystem pass inspection and the assertion fails (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
